description: This Java source file defines the 'Hooks' class for managing WebDriver lifecycle events in Cucumber test scenarios, including setup and teardown, configuration logging, and screenshot capture on failure.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: Manages WebDriver lifecycle for each Cucumber scenario, including initialization, configuration logging, and capturing screenshots on failure.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares WebDriver before scenario execution, logs environment info, and skips driver init for database-only scenarios if database isn't configured.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Handles scenario cleanup after execution, captures screenshots if failed, and times out WebDriver.

methods.name: logConfigOnce
methods.description: Ensures environment configuration is logged only once per test run using thread-safe double-checked locking.

methods.name: isDatabaseOnlyScenario
methods.description: Determines whether a scenario is solely a database scenario based on scenario tags.

methods.name: captureScreenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot on test failure and attaches it to the Cucumber report, handling cases where WebDriver isn't initialized.
